projects.title: Example Project — LLM-based Document Analysis
projects.description: A document analysis pipeline leveraging large language models to extract structured insights from unstructured financial reports. The system combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with fine-tuned embeddings to achieve high-accuracy entity recognition and relation extraction across multiple document formats.

projects.title: Example Project — Economic Data Visualization Dashboard
projects.description: An interactive web dashboard for visualizing regional economic indicators and policy impacts. Built with a focus on reproducibility and real-time data integration, enabling researchers and policymakers to explore complex economic relationships through intuitive visual interfaces.
